summary: Overlays in the root base package: focus trap (FocusTrapElementOf(el).FocusTrap, ActiveFocusTrap; root.go's placeholder replaced), positioner (Align, ResolvedPosition, sides/corners, occlusion), popup (PopupPriority, anchored content), popover (PopoverState, Trigger), tooltip (TooltipOverlay with show delay/grace period), hover card, dialog (DialogHandle, trigger/backdrop/popup/title/description/close), alert dialog, sheet, toast (ToastManager/ToastStack with sprung stacking). base.Init now runs dialog/focus_trap/popover/sheet init (U:lib.rs:232-235; orchestrator).

tests.per_module: positioner 15, popup 3, popover 6, tooltip 3+1, hover_card 3, dialog 6+1, alert_dialog 2+1, sheet 4, toast 11, focus_trap 0+1

orchestrator_rerun.where: git checkout-index snapshot of HEAD f01af3f + the staged ticket-16 files + lib.go (tickets 18/27 in-progress files excluded)

gap_2b_block_sites: every plain upstream div() constructor calls Block() first (popup root, hover-card trigger wrapper + default trigger, dialog trigger wrapper (shared with alert dialog) + closed placeholder + parts + close anchor + backdrop wrapper + host (host still sets Flex itself, U:dialog.rs:560), alert-dialog parts and dispatch wrappers, sheet host + overlay layer, popover content surface + placeholders, tooltip base + renderer wrapper + empty overlay, toast root + stack root); the popup occlusion test harness outer div (U:popup.rs:254, a plain div) also gets Block(). Applied in a follow-up pass at the orchestrator's request; no test result changed.
deviations: no Window.WindowDecorations/Decorations/Tiling in the core: windows are treated as server-decorated (the pinned default, what Windows reports); unexported copies keep the frame-inset logic and its test

NewDialog/NewSheet/NewAlertDialog take no context; without an explicit FocusHandle they use a keyed-state handle released when the dialog stops drawing (upstream allocates one per render and drops it; Go would leak one per frame); DialogClose's anchor handle likewise
popover open-popup registration released with its state entity; dismiss subscription cancelled on close
tooltip/hover-card delays: background timer + foreground continuation, cancelled explicitly where Rust drops the task
focus trap keeps the wrapped element's id one level below the trap id; traps searched in registration order (upstream HashMap order); manager created on demand
toast measured heights keyed by the id's string form; Instant = time.Time; iterators return slices
